title: Generation job and provider abstraction

clientRequestId.replayRule: same request -> same id; expected id with changed material fails closed

rules: DRAFT may be quoted or locally cancelled
QUOTED may submit, requote or cancel
provider success requires a valid bound output manifest before SUCCEEDED
timeout never fabricates provider completion or publication
provider lifecycle is application execution state only and not protocol settlement/publication authority

authorityBoundaries: provider descriptor/capacity is selection input, not canonical protocol authority
provider quote is application/provider information and not canonical payment settlement
provider job success does not imply VERIFIED/SETTLED/REGISTERED/PUBLISHED
provider cannot broaden reference-audio authorization path
provider/model/revision/job identity is frozen across quote/submit/result validation
420Hz does not accept provider-specific error states as canonical cross-provider semantics
HZ-GCA-2 does not implement HZ-GCA-3 420AI/ComputeMarket routing, escrow or settlement
invariants: HZGCA2-001 deterministic normalized request material produces one deterministic client request id
HZGCA2-002 changed material cannot be accepted under a mismatched expected client request id
HZGCA2-003 reference audio is rejected unless it uses an explicitly permitted authorization path
HZGCA2-004 provider/model/revision identity is bound at quote and checked at submit/result
HZGCA2-005 quote includes cost and capacity envelope with explicit expiry
HZGCA2-006 submit is idempotent and retry does not duplicate provider jobs
HZGCA2-007 transient provider failure is normalized into provider-independent retryable errors
HZGCA2-008 timeout fails locally without fabricating provider success or output
HZGCA2-009 cancellation is explicit before or after provider submission
HZGCA2-010 provider success is accepted only with a valid MIX-bearing output manifest
HZGCA2-011 output artifact identity/integrity references remain provider-neutral storage references
HZGCA2-012 mix/stems/lyrics-timing/artwork are represented through one provider-neutral artifact vocabulary
HZGCA2-013 provider capability drift after quote fails closed
HZGCA2-014 provider error codes are diagnostic only and mapped into frozen application error taxonomy
HZGCA2-015 provider state never becomes Creative/Rights/payment/settlement/publication authority
HZGCA2-016 implementation remains usable with deterministic mock provider and future provider adapters
HZGCA2-017 HZ-GCA-2 introduces no provider-specific canonical protocol dependency
HZGCA2-018 HZ-GCA-3 remains the owner of 420AI/ComputeMarket execution routing and settlement integration
exitCriteria: provider-neutral generation request and job model exists
lifecycle, cancellation, timeout, replay and failure/retry behavior are tested
reference audio is restricted to authorized paths
provider cannot become canonical protocol authority
targeted exact-head Level-1 workflow passes with no skipped required checks
